The Lantern Barge Won't Wait

Festival night on the black canal. Every village downstream stays dark until your barges carry the light.

🏮 lit 0💧 drowned 0job 1 of 5
Dockmaster: Boots on, loader.
REFUSE JOB ✂
LAUNCH 🔔

Two barges left this dock an hour ago.

every rack the same → sailed through the sea gate
🏮🏮 🏮🏮🏮🏮 🏮
racks uneven → tipped, lanterns drowned
